small, deterministic HTTP API for D&D 5e style helpers.\nIt runs on OpenJDK with only the Java standard library and uses an external `sqlite3` binary for persistence.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles the Java sources under `dnd/` and runs `dnd.Main` in the foreground.\nThe server listens on `127.0.0.1` and honors the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`).\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n```\ndnd/\n  Main.java                 # entry point: opens the HTTP socket and wires the router\n  handlers/\n    RequestRouter.java      # registers all HTTP contexts; delegates to domain handlers\n    BaseHandler.java        # shared response helpers, error constants, authentication\n    CoreHandler.java        # health, dice stats, checks, encounter math, initiative, character rules\n    CombatHandler.java      # persisted combat sessions\n    AuthHandler.java        # user registration and login (PBKDF2 hashing)\n    StorageHandler.java     # storage status and reset\n    CompendiumHandler.java  # monster and item compendium entries\n    CampaignHandler.java    # campaigns: characters, events, quests, factions, NPCs, inventory,\n                            # equipment, crafting, sessions, analytics, export\n    PhbHandler.java         # Player's Handbook helpers: spell slots, rests, equipment load\n    DmToolHandler.java      # DM helpers: encounter builder, loot parcel, session recap\n    PlayCampaignHandler.java # play-surface campaigns: membership, turn queue, actions/resolutions,\n                             # nudges, documents, role-filtered views\n  server/\n    HttpSupport.java        # read request bodies, send JSON responses\n  game/\n    Rules.java              # dice, XP, encounter difficulty, ability modifiers, open-thread derivation\n  json/\n    JsonParser.java         # minimal recursive-descent JSON parser\n    JsonUtils.java          # JSON serialization and int coercion\n  model/\n    Combatant.java          # initiative combatant\n    CombatSession.java      # persisted encounter\n    Condition.java          # status condition on a combatant\n    User.java               # registered user with salt/hash\n  storage/\n    Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database.\n`Storage` shells out to the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a single `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by `Storage.reset()`.\n\nCommon persistence helpers live in `Storage` as private methods:\n- `executeInsert(...)` runs a write transaction and maps `UNIQUE` constraint failures to `false` so callers can return `409`.\n- `queryCount(...)` simplifies `SELECT COUNT(*) AS c` reads.\n- `quote(...)` escapes single quotes for SQLite string literals.\n\nTables:\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events`, `quests`, `quest_milestones` — campaign state, session log, and quest tracker.\n- `factions`, `npcs` — campaign factions and NPCs with relationship disposition.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled campaign sessions and per-character attendance.\n- `play_campaigns` — protected play-surface campaigns owned by a `dm` user.\n- `play_campaign_members` — player memberships in a play campaign, with one row per `(campaign_id, username)` and unique `character_id` per campaign.\n- `play_campaign_narrations` — append-only campaign log: narration, action, resolution, nudge, scene-enter, travel, and rest events.\n\n### Routing\n\n`Main` creates an `HttpServer` from `com.sun.net.httpserver`, builds a `RequestRouter`, and calls `router.register(server)` to attach all contexts.\n`RequestRouter` does not implement request logic itself; it instantiates domain handlers and wires contexts to handler methods.\n\nShared handler infrastructure lives in `BaseHandler`:\n- `requireMethod`, `badRequest`, `notFound`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`\n- exact JSON error-body constants\n- `authenticate` — validates `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>` and supports deterministic fixture tokens even after a storage reset.\n\nHandlers are grouped by domain and file:\n\n- **Core:** `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`, `/v1/characters/*`\n- **Combat:** `/v1/combat/sessions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance`\n- **Auth:** `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login`\n- **Storage:** `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset`\n- **Compendium:** `/v1/compendium/monsters`, `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`, `/v1/compendium/items`, `/v1/compendium/items/{slug}`\n- **Campaigns:** `/v1/campaigns`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/state`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/characters`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/events`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/factions`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/{project_id}/advance`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/next`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/{session_id}/attendance`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/export`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/audit`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/{quest_id}/progress`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/summary`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory/summary`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/characters/{character_id}/equipment`\n- **PHB rules:** `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load`\n- **DM tools:** `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap`\n- **Play campaigns:** `/v1/play/campaigns`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/resolutions`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/travel`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/rest`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/my-turn`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{char_id}/build`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/turn/delay`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/turn/ready`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/rewards`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/close`\n\nMost handlers validate the request body, throw `RuntimeException` on bad input, and translate any exception into a `400` response. Missing resources return `404`. Conflicts return `409`.\n\n### JSON handling\n\nRequests and responses are JSON. The built-in `JsonParser` and `JsonUtils` are intentionally minimal and preserve the exact output format expected by the test suite:\n\n- Field order is determined by `LinkedHashMap` insertion order.\n- Numbers without a fractional part are serialized as integers.\n- Only standard escape sequences are supported.\n\nIf you change serialization, ensure the test suite output format stays identical.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Initiative and combat\n\n- `POST /v1/initiative/order` — sorts combatants by `roll + dex`, breaking ties by dex then name.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions` — creates a persisted combat session with a sorted order and returns the first active combatant.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions` — adds a timed condition to a combatant in the session.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance` — advances the turn tracker, increments the round on wrap, and decrements/removes conditions on the newly active combatant.\n\n### Encounter math\n\n- `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp` — calculates base XP, multiplier, adjusted XP, and difficulty thresholds for a party.\n- `POST /v1/dm/encounter-builder` — looks up monster slugs from the compendium and delegates to the same encounter math.\n\n### Compendium and campaigns\n\n- Monsters and items are created by slug and read back by slug.\n- Campaigns own characters and a chronological event log.\n- `POST /v1/dm/session-recap` reads the latest campaign event and derives an open-thread hook from its summary.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/factions` creates a campaign faction.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs` creates a campaign NPC linked to a faction.\n- `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships` returns faction and NPC counts, including `friendly_npcs` (NPCs with `disposition > 0`).\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting` creates a downtime crafting project for a character (returns `days_completed: 0` and `status: active`).\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/{project_id}/advance` advances a project by `days`; when `days_completed` reaches `days_required` the project becomes `complete` and the crafted item is added to the campaign inventory with owner `party`.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions` schedules a session with an agenda and returns the session id, start time, duration, and `agenda_count`.\n- `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/next` returns the earliest scheduled session (`id`, `starts_at`, `agenda_count`).\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/{session_id}/attendance` records present and absent characters and returns the counts.\n- `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/summary` returns a deterministic readiness score plus counts for open quests, friendly NPCs, scheduled sessions, and inventory items.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/risk-report` (body `{\"include_zeroes\": true}`) returns the campaign risk level, missing readiness signals, and booleans for `has_dm`, `has_characters`, `has_next_session`, and `has_active_quest`.\n\n### Play campaigns\n\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns` creates a play campaign. Requires an `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>` header; only `dm` users may create. Returns the created campaign with `owner`, `status: \"lobby\"`, and `max_players`.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members` lets an authenticated player join a lobby campaign. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only `player` users may join. Body `{\"character_id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\",\"class\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with `username`, `character_id`, `name`, and `class`. A player may own at most one membership per campaign, character IDs must be unique within the campaign, and the party cannot exceed `max_players`; any of those conflicts returns 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start` starts a lobby campaign. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may start. A lobby campaign with at least two party members becomes `active` exactly once and returns `{\"id\":\"...\",\"status\":\"active\",\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"turn_number\":1}`, where `current_actor` is the alphabetically first party member. Returns 403 for non-owners or players, 404 if the campaign does not exist, and 409 if the campaign is already active or has fewer than two members.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn` reads the current turn. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner or a party member may read. Returns the campaign's `current_actor`, `phase` (`lobby`, `dm`, or `player`), `turn_number`, a deterministic `queue`, plus deterministic timeout metadata: `overdue` (`false` for a fresh turn) and a logical integer `logical_deadline`. For an active campaign, the queue is built by alternating each party member (in the deterministic party order) with the DM — for example, a two-player party yields `[\"player-a\",\"dm\",\"player-b\",\"dm\"]`. Lobby campaigns return an empty queue. The deadline is a logical integer derived from the turn number; wall-clock time is not used.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge` lets the campaign owner send a nonempty reminder message to the current actor. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may call it. Body `{\"message\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with `actor` (the owner), `target` (the campaign's `current_actor`), `message`, and a monotonically increasing `nudge_count`. The nudge is also appended to the campaign log as a `nudge` event. Players and non-members receive 403; unauthenticated requests receive 401; an empty message returns 400.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/my-turn` returns the player-specific turn context for an authenticated party member with role `player`. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; returns 401 if unauthenticated, 403 for non-players or non-members, and 404 if the campaign does not exist. Returns `{\"is_my_turn\":bool,\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"character\":{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\"},\"recent_events\":[...]}`. The player only sees their own character (id and name) and the public campaign log events (narration, action, resolution, nudge, scene-enter, travel, rest); no DM-private fields are exposed.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status` returns the owner-only GM turn context. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may read. Players receive 403. Returns `{\"needs_attention\":bool,\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"party\":[...],\"recent_events\":[...]}`. `needs_attention` is `true` exactly when the current actor is the owner. `party` is a summary of all party members (`username`, `character_id`, `name`, `class`). `recent_events` are the public campaign log events (narration, action, resolution, nudge, scene-enter, travel, rest).\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations` appends a DM narration event. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may narrate. Body `{\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"narration\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"...\"}`. Sequence starts at 1 for each campaign and is append-only. Players receive 403.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions` lets the active party player submit an action. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the player whose username matches the campaign's `current_actor` may submit. Body `{\"type\":\"...\",\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"action\",\"actor\":\"...\",\"type\":\"...\",\"text\":\"...\",\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}`, advances the campaign's `current_actor` to the DM, and increments the turn number. A waiting player or the DM receives 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/resolutions` lets the campaign owner resolve the current DM turn. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the owner may call it when `current_actor` is the owner. Body `{\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"...\",\"next_actor\":\"...\",\"turn_number\":1}`, advances the campaign's `current_actor` to the next party member in the deterministic queue, and returns the current turn number. A player attempting resolution receives 409.\n- `PUT /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` updates the durable, role-filtered campaign document. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner may update. Body `{\"story\":\"...\",\"dm_notes\":\"...\"}`. Returns 200 with both `story` and `dm_notes`.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` reads the campaign document. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; the owner receives both `story` and `dm_notes`, while a party player receives only `story`. Non-members and players attempting to update receive 403.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/locations` creates a location for the campaign. Owner-only. Body `{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the created location; duplicate IDs return 409. If the party has no current location, the new location becomes the party's current location.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/locations/{from_id}/connections` creates a directed travel connection between two locations. Owner-only. Body `{\"to_id\":\"...\",\"travel_turns\":...}`. Returns 201 with `{\"from_id\":\"...\",\"to_id\":\"...\",\"travel_turns\":...}`; missing destinations and already-connected destinations return 400.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/locations/{loc_id}/travel` reads outbound connections for a location. Any campaign member. Returns `{\"destinations\":[{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\",\"travel_turns\":...}]}`.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/scenes/{scene_id}/enter` sets the current scene and appends a `scene` event to the campaign log. The party's current location is tracked independently by locations and travel.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/travel` lets the active party player spend an exploration turn to travel to a connected location. Body `{\"destination_id\":\"...\"}`. Only the current actor may call it, and the destination must be a valid outbound connection from the party's current location. Returns 201 with `{\"sequence\":...,\"kind\":\"travel\",\"actor\":\"...\",\"destination_id\":\"...\",\"travel_turns\":...,\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}`; advances the current actor to the DM and updates the party's current location. Acting out of turn or choosing an invalid destination returns 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/rest` lets the active party player take a short or long rest as an exploration turn. Body `{\"type\":\"long\"}` or `{\"type\":\"short\"}`. Only the current actor may call it. Returns 201 with `{\"sequence\":...,\"kind\":\"rest\",\"actor\":\"...\",\"type\":\"...\",\"hp_current\":...,\"hp_max\":...,\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}`. A long rest restores `hp_current` to `hp_max`. Acting out of turn returns 409; an invalid type returns 400.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters` creates a campaign-bound encounter. Owner-only. Body `{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with `{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\",\"status\":\"active\",\"combatants\":[]}`. Duplicate encounter IDs or an already-active encounter return 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/monsters` adds a deterministic monster combatant to an encounter. Owner-only. Body `{\"monster_id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\",\"hp_max\":...,\"initiative\":...}`. Returns 201 with the monster fields and `hp_current` set to `hp_max`. Duplicate `monster_id` values within the same encounter return 409.\n- `DELETE /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/monsters/{monster_id}` removes a monster from an encounter. Owner-only. No mutable state should live in handlers.\n2. **Use `LinkedHashMap` for deterministic JSON output.** The test suite compares exact JSON strings in many places, so shared error response bodies are kept as exact string constants in `BaseHandler`.\n3. **Preserve the JSON number format.** `JsonUtils.toJson` emits integers for whole numbers and doubles otherwise.\n4. **Validate with `RuntimeException`.** Handlers catch generic exceptions and map them to `400`. Use explicit validation messages for debugging, but never leak them in the HTTP body.\n5. **Use the storage lock for concurrency.** `Storage` serializes all database access. int currentIndex, int newIndex) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatants = listPlayCampaignEncounterCombatants(campaignId, encounterId);\n            int size = combatants.size();\n            if (currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex >= size || newIndex <= currentIndex || newIndex >= size) return;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> reordered = new ArrayList<>(combatants);\n            Map<String, Object> current = reordered.remove(currentIndex);\n            reordered.add(newIndex, current);\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            for (int i = 0; i < reordered.size(); i++) {\n                String id = (String) reordered.get(i).get(\"id\");\n                String kind = (String) sort_order = \" + sortOrder + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND monster_id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n                } else {\n                    sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_combatants SET sort_order = \" + sortOrder + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND member = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n                }\n            }\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET turn_index = \" + newIndex + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND monster_id = \" + quote(target) + \";\");\n            if (!rows.isEmpty()) {\n                int hpBefore = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"hp_current\"));\n                int hpAfter = Math.max(0, hpBefore - amount);\n                execSql(\"UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = \" + hpAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND monster_id = \" + quote(target) + \";\");\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                res.put(\"hp_before\", hpBefore);\n                res.put(\"hp_after\", hpAfter);\n                res.put(\"damage\", amount);\n                return res;\n            }\n            rows = query(\"SELECT m.hp_current, m.hp_max, m.status FROM play_campaign_members m JOIN play_campaign_encounter_combatants c ON m.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND m.username = c.member WHERE c.campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND c.encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND c.member = \" + quote(target) + \";\");\n            if (!rows.isEmpty()) {\n                int hpBefore = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"hp_current\"));\n                int hpMax = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"hp_max\"));\n                String status = (String) rows.get(0).get(\"status\");\n                int hpAfter = Math.max(0, hpBefore - amount);\n                       newStatus = \"unconscious\";\n                    } else {\n                        newStatus = \"conscious\";\n                        successes = 0;\n                        failures = 0;\n                    }\n                }\n                execSql(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = \" + hpAfter + \", status = \" + quote(newStatus) + \", Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                res.put(\"hp_before\", hpBefore);\n                res.put(\"hp_after\", hpAfter);\n                res.put(\"damage\", amount);\n                return res;\n            }\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> applyHealToEncounterTarget(String List<String> milestones = new ArrayList<>();\n            Set<String> completed = new HashSet<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> milestoneRows = query(\"SELECT milestone, completed FROM        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean updateQuestProgress(String campaignId, String id, List<String> completed) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            try {\n                List<String> sqls =            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            for (int i = 0; i < reordered.size(); i++) {\n                String id = (String) reordered.get(i).get(\"id\");\n                String kind = (String)                       newStatus = \"unconscious\";\n                    } else {\n                        newStatus = \"conscious\";\n                        successes = 0;\n                        failures = 0;\n                    }\n                }\n                execSql(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = \" + hpAfter + \", status = \" + quote(newStatus) + \", Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                res.put(\"hp_before\", hpBefore);\n                res.put(\"hp_after\", hpAfter);\n                res.put(\"damage\", amount);\n                return res;\n            }\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> applyHealToEncounterTarget(String        String status = (String) project.get(\"status\");\n            if (\"complete\".equals(status)) {\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n
